tagline: An EDA environment for schematics, PCB layout, verification and simulation. Only the corpus inventory is written.
description: EH3D-PHOENIX-PCB is planned as an EDA environment with schematic capture, PCB layout, verification tools, circuit simulation and specialized modules for switch-mode power supplies and RF. Today it holds a workspace with a redacted inventory of a private corpus of design files and a command line for it; it has only run on folders made by its own tests, and the design model, readers, rules and editors are not written.
